clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

The price follows index CU-NOTATION: P = P0 x (1 - 0.55 + 0.55 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 0 %.
Delivery DAP; standard lead time 14 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

persona.summary: Kabelwerk Rhönsberg GmbH, group-owned cable maker (400 staff); we are 0.85 % of its turnover; it is our sole source for motor cable. The contract has a CU-NOTATION index clause (55 % share), yet its copper is bought forward until March 2027. Price rose 21.9 % since the start and sits 3.9 % over its should-cost. The contract ends 2026-12-31 with 60-day notice. Push the hedge against index pass-through and use its complaint record.
persona.notes: Asked for our expected volumes for the renewal. Contradiction: the index passes market copper to us quarterly while its own copper is fixed until March 2027, so any pass-through before April 2027 is a windfall. Complaint record: 24 in three years, EUR 2,550 recharged) and OTD of 81-89 %. The Oct 2026 cable recycling line news is noise.

index clause: CU-NOTATION, material share 0.55, adjusted quarterly
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

levers: index terms: lower share, base reset, deadband
arguments: its own hedge: copper cost fixed until March 2027
avoid: dropping the index entirely (it is in the current contract)
threatening a second source we do not have
changing terms after a final offer
tactics: Cite its hedge: no index pass-through or increase before April 2027.
Keep an index clause but cut the material share or add a deadband.
Use the complaint record (24 in three years) as the quality argument.
Answer its volume request with a binding annual volume in exchange for price.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; it kept only 0.27 of its asks historically, but in 2025 it kept 6.0 % of an 8.6 % ask.
